thread:
alex: Kicking off a staggered promotion of payments-chart v2.4.0 to eu-west. Canaries passed initially but post-canary checks show a values drift for TZ-related env (PAYMENT_TZ). Seeing ~1-2% billing event mis-attribution on edge nodes. Holding before the next wave. Thoughts?

deploy-bot: Canary 1 (eu-west-1a) -> PASS (pods healthy). Post-check: billing-consistency alert triggered (rule: payment-event-timestamp-diff > 200ms) on 3 pods. Logs attached -> `kubectl logs -l app=payments -n prod --tail=100` shows timezone offset warnings.

maria: hmm could be the values overlay for edgezone got wrong copy. I remember a recent values-merge that added `PAYMENT_TZ: UTC` in chart defaults but edgezone expected `PAYMENT_TZ: local`.

sam: Is the chart bump only includes config map change or code? If it's just values we can hotpatch without rollback. Can you paste the diff?

alex: It's a values-only tweak. Diff: `payments/values.yaml` v2.3.9 -> v2.4.0: +PAYMENT_TZ: UTC (default). Edge overlay was relying on unset to pick node-local timezone. The helm release promotion used overlay merge that may have dropped the overlay key.

release-lead: We have a change window until 02:00 UTC. Options: 1) Pause rollout and patch edge overlays to explicitly set PAYMENT_TZ: local, resume. 2) Rollback canary to 2.3.9 across promoted waves. 3) Continue and accept 1-2% drift (not great). Recommend option 1.

maria: Agreed with option 1. Quick patch: `kubectl -n prod set env daemonset/edge-config PAYMENT_TZ=local --overwrite`? That will update nodes picking it up via env. But the proper fix is to push overlay values for each edge namespace.

sam: Do we have an automated job that rewrites overlay values on promotion? Might be a bug in the promotion script that collapsed empty keys. I'll open a follow-up PR. For now we should patch live.

alex: Plan: pause remaining waves (hold promotion), apply live env patch for edge nodes, validate billing metric for ~2m, then decide to continue promotion. If the hotpatch does not fix in 10m, rollback canary to 2.3.9.

deploy-bot: Action queued: `promotion: pause` by alex at 3467890129.

maria: Running patch: 
```
kubectl -n prod get ds edge-config -o yaml | sed 's/PAYMENT_TZ:.*/PAYMENT_TZ: local/' | kubectl apply -f -
```
Applying now.

maria: patch applied to edge-config daemonset. Rolling update started.

deploy-bot: Health check: edge pods restart complete. Post-patch billing-consistency alert cleared for the previous 3 pods.

sam: Nice. Can we run a smoke check across a few tenants? I'll kick the synthetic billing job.

sam: synthetic job run -> no timestamp diffs observed in 5/5 samples. Looks good.

release-lead: consensus: resume staggered promotion, but pin the overlay merge flow: add a preflight step to verify overlays are preserved (CI check). Also add a release-note entry about defaulting PAYMENT_TZ->UTC causing edge mismatch.

alex: I'll resume promotion manually and monitor next wave closely. I'll also create ticket INF-1428 to patch the deploy-promote script.

alex: resume promotion (wave 2) at 3467890200.

deploy-bot: Wave 2 -> starting (eu-west-1b).

deploy-bot: Wave 2 canary healthy, post-checks clear. No billing drift.

release-lead: Action items assigned: 
- alex: follow-up ticket INF-1428 + manual resume logs and release-note blurb.
- sam: PR for promotion script preflight (verify overlay keys).
- maria: backfill edge overlay values in helmrepo and open a patch PR.

alex: Release notes snippet -> "payments-chart v2.4.0: default PAYMENT_TZ set to UTC. If you run edge deployments that rely on node-local timezone, set overlay PAYMENT_TZ to desired value. Hotpatch applied to edge nodes during promotion due to detected drift." Link: https://go/release-notes/payments/2.4.0-draft

maria: I'll push the overlay PR now, include test that validates `PAYMENT_TZ` presence for edge overlays.

sam: Good incident-free resolution. Marking thread resolved unless anyone objects. :white_check_mark:

alex: No objections. I'll close after INF-1428 is created and release-note published.

deploy-bot: promotion complete. All waves successful. artifacts: helm-chart payments-2.4.0.tgz, promotion-log: https://go/promote/3467890123/log

alex: thanks all.
